svg.title: Phase 2D-B proposal: identify the source of Guardian damage
svg.desc: Code-native mobile mockup. Upper 844 by 390 area follows approved A3 HUD anchors. Proposed tower attack trace, Guardian hit accent and contextual notice are annotated below. World geometry is schematic; no runtime changes.

g.text: 24px gesture reserve · no added touch target
1 Brief tower → victim trace on an actual attack; not a projectile or warning window.
2 One local hit accent + HP pulse for positive damage; no repeated number stacks.
3 Use the existing combat notice slot. No extra HUD row or covered control.
Illustrative state and schematic world positions; approved A3 HUD anchors and original icons.
Numbered markers and the lower notes are review annotations, not game UI.
